errors.text: The target TaVCrW composition and initially disordered BCC solid are replaced by an unspecified Ta-based alloy treated primarily as a liquid.

The intervention conflates free-energy perturbation between MTP and DFT with an alchemical or ideal-liquid transformation and even describes the replacement as thermodynamic integration, obscuring the key FEP estimator.
The proposed 5–10% validation tolerances are far too loose to establish accuracy for sub-meV/atom free-energy differences and could falsely label a biased potential as successful.

Training on configurations from different alloy chemistries such as MoNbTaW or WTaMoNbV, rather than representative TaVCrW liquid configurations, creates the exact out-of-domain artifact the intervention must avoid.
